notes.title: Many fixes and improvements :)
notes.content: Leaderboards should now load very quickly and replays begin downloading from the top. The player is now given prompts as to what the main interaction keys will do depending on whether they are using controller or gamepad. The game now compares system time to local timescale to detect speedhacking :)

notes.title: Improved level preview images for Workshop and in game.
notes.content:
So far the level previews have consisted of displaying the level data image, which looked bad. Now when the player enters the level select screen for the first time, 'pretty' preview images will be generated and saved to disk for quick retrieval in future.

Also, a prettier preview is also generated when the player uploads a level to workshop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016510/a3517d32266923c81aa8ef7f0388aeb320834116.png[/img]

notes.title: Workshop content can now be subscribed to in-game. Top player trophies.
notes.content:
Players can now use an in game workshop content view to subscribe to levels rather than having to use the web interface. The web interface is still available for more complex interactions, though the in game viewer is much easier for new players to navigate as it is not cluttered by replays.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016510/7b227caafe61ef56bbf8869913b6bb06ff73f9a3.png[/img]The player with the fastest time on a leader board will now see the button for that leader board appear in gold, as well as a gold trophy icon. This is only visible while the player holds the top spot.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016510/7b227caafe61ef56bbf8869913b6bb06ff73f9a3.png[/img]

notes.title: Racing against leader board ghosts should now be working.
notes.content:
The feature that enables players to race against other players ghosts on the leader board should now work as expected (fingers crossed). 

I have made configuration changes to the workshop that will hopefully allow some players who are having problems to download workshop data.

I'm also hoping to introduce some performance improvements over the next few days.

 I have made many changes and fixes over the last couple of days and the todo list is growing.

notes.title: ASTRO-NOT Playtest is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone :)

The playtest is finally live and of course it is completely broken :/

I had not set the steam cloud data limits for the playtest and had not configured the workshop for the playtest at all. I had just assumed the playtest would use the workshop for the regular game but that is not the case.

So none of the online features are working as of right now but I am on it :)

There also seems to be a major problem with the adventure world filesystem that is stopping users from accessing or creating worlds. I am also working to resolve this and don't anticipate it should take long.

Thanks for your patience and I will keep you all updated.
